case: The Lady of the Dunes / Provincetown Jane Doe (Cape Cod, Massachusetts, 1974)
angle: A woman's body was found on Race Point Beach in July 1974, unidentified for 48 years until DNA identified her as Ruth Marie Terry in 2022 — but her killer is still unknown, and a persistent theory places her as an uncredited extra in the film Jaws, shot nearby the following year.
